title: Do Pilots Know Their Limits? Code, decision log, and aggregate results
description:
Analysis code, the dated decision log, and aggregate results for the paper "Do Pilots Know Their Limits? Comparing Revealed Wind Limits with Measured Approach Performance Using ADS-B". The study estimates the crosswind at which general aviation pilots stop flying from public ADS-B data, counts approaches flown above the maximum demonstrated crosswind, and scores approaches against stabilized approach criteria at 300 ft, at 467 airports in the contiguous United States. No per-aircraft or per-approach data is included.

The code is released under the MIT License. The aggregate results are derived from ADSB.lol data and are released under the Open Database License 1.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
notes: Aggregate results and tables are derived from the ADSB.lol globe history archive and are licensed under the Open Database License 1.0 (odbl-1.0).
